interface_authority: Actual registered source/runtime and describe_engine take precedence over latest public documentation. Parameters must map to emitted config/API/CLI; no invented effective controls.

zh-CN: 先检查真实CV/Bias/Switch/Neighbor库，再组合已支持的图；构造参数按原库名称和类型呈现。
区分源码默认值、GUI演示值、由结构推导的值、用户指定值与试运行提案。
MetaD scale为维度开关，sigma/scale按完整CV顺序保存；CV顺序改变须同步相关参数并废止旧产物证据。
首次库外CV须先确认公式/定义域/单位，再生成独立私有库代码；数值检验与物理适用性分开。
en: Use actual GUI catalog params and graph semantics, not prose or native CV/bias bypass.
Neighbor selection, atom groups, scalar/vector rank, reducer and ordered collector are scientific definitions.
Use actual bias constructor keys including sigma/weight/scale/temp/bias_factor and pdl for the actual periodic family; OPES uses its separate settings, never replace exact keys with invented aliases.
GAScfg cv_size/n_atoms/neighbor_rc/max_neighbors/cv_storage_interval/max_cv_nums must match saved model and planned history.
Reload serialized artifact and verify real-neighbor forces/virial and selected target separately.
Runtime turns load functional guide and selected observed runtime; installation/AOTI-build manuals are not routine context.
